title: Bug: Matching engine mutates listing quantities across repeated simulations
description: The MatchingEngine updates listing.quantity in place. If the same listing objects are reused for simulation or analytics runs, results drift unexpectedly. Create an immutable planning mode or deep-copy strategy and add regression tests.

title: Feature: Add waitlist priority scoring for vulnerable households
description: Add configurable priority weights (household size, urgency, trust_score, age of request) and update matching to use weighted ordering rather than simple FIFO. Include deterministic tie-breaking.

title: Bug: SSO validator accepts non-email identifiers without normalization
description: BasicSSOProvider validates signature but does not validate email format or casing normalization. Add robust email checks and normalized identity handling.

title: Feature: Add audit log endpoint for donation lifecycle
description: Introduce an append-only audit log model for create/update/match/fulfillment events and expose a paginated API endpoint filtered by listing_id and user_id.

title: Bug: Distance calculation produces collisions between unrelated postcodes
description: _postal_distance currently uses a simplistic character-sum modulo approach that maps many different postcodes to identical distances. Replace with a deterministic but less collision-prone strategy.

title: Feature: Introduce role-based access control for moderators
description: Add roles (member, moderator, admin) and enforce permissions on listing moderation and issue-resolution workflows. Include authorization middleware and tests.

title: Bug: Demo /demo/matches endpoint can return stale timestamps
description: The endpoint generates timestamps at multiple points and can produce inconsistent ordering in edge conditions. Refactor to use a single request timestamp source.

title: Feature: Add recurring donation subscriptions for vegetable growers
description: Allow users to schedule recurring weekly or monthly vegetable donations with pause/resume support and conflict resolution when inventory is low.

title: Bug: Missing pagination in future list endpoints may cause memory spikes
description: Planned list endpoints should be paginated. Define reusable pagination contracts and protect against large payloads to avoid memory pressure.

title: Feature: Build recommendation engine for nearby book swaps
description: Recommend listings using user interests, prior matches, and locality constraints. Start with a heuristic baseline and leave extension points for model-based ranking.
